name: Crustless quiche
author: The Wickham family
steps: Cook onion, garlic and butter until tender.
Cool and add eggs, salt and milk.
Pour into large bowl and add flour, then stir with fork.
Pour into well sprayed 23cm flan tin.

culture.text: Quiche is a French tart consisting of a pastry case filled with savory custard and pieces of cheese, meat, seafood or vegetables. A well-known variant is Quiche Lorraine, which includes lardons or bacon. Quiche are served hot, warm or cold.
